---

name: DOI request
about: Ask for a NEMAR DOI for a release of a specification or of software
title: "DOI request: nemar.<name>.v<version>"
labels: []
---

Read [`docs/minting.md`](https://github.com/nemarOrg/nemar-doi/blob/main/docs/minting.md) first.
A DOI is permanent: it is never deleted and never pointed at something else.
Dataset DOIs are not requested here; they come from publishing a dataset through NEMAR.

**DOI requested** (for example `10.82901/nemar.biosig-zarr.v3.0.0`):

**What it identifies** (repository, release tag, and the commit the tag points at):

**Is the name new?** (a new name needs the owner's approval)

**Creators** (the people named in the `CITATION.cff` of the source repository at the tagged commit, each by given and family name with an ORCID iD where they have one; an organization only where no person can be named):

**Title, publication year, one-paragraph abstract, license:**

**Your role in the source repository:**
